decisions.diagnosis: zero_outage removed a genuinely quiet spell; the other direction was just as low, so the counter was working.
decisions.evidence: 2021-08-24 raw 93=29, 94=24; hour by hour 94 tracks 93 (e.g. 07-09h 3/3, 17h 5/4), so this was not a dead tube.

decisions.diagnosis: zero_outage removed real low counts during the very wet early-July 2022 weekend; both directions dropped together.
decisions.evidence: Raw 93/94 were 17/13 on 07-02 and 23/16 on 07-03; dir 94 had non-zero slots all through the flagged stretch at the same level as dir 93.

decisions.diagnosis: Dir 93 undercounted all day just before an outage, which points to a damaged tube; dir 94 looked normal.
decisions.evidence: 93=193 vs 94=579; 93 17h=20 vs 93-141 on the days before; 93 was at about 20-30% of normal in every hour.

decisions.diagnosis: Counter was out until noon on a weekday (dir 93 read all zeros, dir 94 near zeros), then recovered, so the day is partial.
decisions.evidence: 00-11h: 93 read 0 in every hour; 94 read 11 in total vs about 400 normally before noon; both were normal from 12h on.

decisions.diagnosis: Both directions read exactly zero from 00:00 to 12:59 on a Thursday (counter outage, probably maintenance), so the day total is partial.
decisions.evidence: Every slot from 00:00 to 12:45 was 0 in both directions; the adjacent weekdays had about 150-200 bikes in the 7-8h peak alone.

decisions.diagnosis: Direction labels swapped around midday on 2023-09-18 (tube reinstalled reversed): the commute peaks flip from one direction to the other with no change in the total.
decisions.evidence: Share of the weekday 7-9h peak in dir 93 (NW, citybound) was 0.73-0.77 every month from 2022-03 to 2023-08, then 0.22-0.28 every month from 2023-10; on 09-18 dir 93 carried both the AM (187 vs 64) and PM (193 vs 71) peaks; the site total was steady across the change.

summary: A single Metrocount tube counter (2021-06 to 2026-09) with very clean, continuous data; the halving on 2022-02-19 is correct (all 145 non-zero slots even). Two zero_outage fixes on dir 94 removed genuinely quiet days and should be restored, and two partial-day outages plus one day of undercounting in 2024 should be set missing. From midday 2023-09-18 the two direction labels are swapped, so the split is wrong from then on but the totals are right.
